# Pulse Convert — DeepSeek Harness MCP Plugin (`dsh-plugin`)
**Pulse Convert** is an enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)*
*, developed by Office Solution AI Labs.
It empowers DeepSeek coding and data engineering agents with automated assessment capabilities acros
s **40+ legacy BI, ETL, and Data Warehouse platforms** modernizing to **Microsoft Fabric**, **Power
BI**, and **Databricks**.
This plugin connects natively to the live Pulse Convert MCP service via high-performance **Streamabl
e HTTP**. **No local Python installation or runtime dependencies required.**
## 🚀 Features & Tools
When connected, DeepSeek Harness gains direct access to 4 specialized modernization tools:

| Tool | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`get_supported_migrations`** | Catalogs all 24 source pla

tforms and 49 supported modernization pathways across BI, ETL, and DWH. |
| **`assess_migration`** |
Generates instant complexity scoring, manual vs automated timeline comparisons, and workload bluepr

ints. |
| **`lookup_migration_architecture`** | Returns star-schema modeling rules, semantic transla

tion guidelines, and gotchas for any source platform. |
| **`create_assessment_request`** | Collects
enterprise project scope and schedules an in-depth technical discovery consultation with Office Sol
ect scope and schedules an in-depth technical discovery consultation with Office Solution AI Labs. |

## 🔒 Security & Privacy

* **Zero Local Execution:** Operates as a pure client-side manifest connecting over secure HTTPS.
*
**Encrypted in Transit:** All communication between DSH and the Pulse Convert MCP server is protecte

d by industry-standard TLS (HTTPS).
* **Privacy Policy:** Full privacy policy and data protection te
rms are available at https://mcp.innovationalofficesolution.com/pulse-convert/privacy.html.
